name: Indian Historical Fiction
description: Sweeping epics set during the Mughal era, British Raj, or ancient empires.

chapters.title: The Era's Dawn
chapters.description: Establishing the historical setting, political climate, and the protagonist's place in it.

chapters.title: The Inciting Decree
chapters.description: A historical event (a new tax, a war, an invasion) disrupts daily life.

chapters.title: The Royal Court
chapters.description: Intrigue, spies, and danger within the halls of power.

chapters.title: The Forbidden Romance
chapters.description: Love across societal, religious, or political boundaries.

chapters.title: The Gathering Storm
chapters.description: Signs of impending rebellion or war; picking sides.

chapters.title: The Betrayal
chapters.description: A trusted ally switches allegiance for power or survival.

chapters.title: The Uprising
chapters.description: The outbreak of conflict; the protagonist takes a stand.

chapters.title: The Siege
chapters.description: A prolonged period of suffering and testing of resolve.

chapters.title: The Desperate Mission
chapters.description: A risky maneuver to turn the tide of history.

chapters.title: The Historic Clash
chapters.description: The climactic battle or political showdown.

chapters.title: The Aftermath
chapters.description: Surveying the cost of victory; the landscape has changed forever.

chapters.title: The Legacy
chapters.description: How the protagonist's actions echo into the future.
